name: S.Y.K ~Shinsetsu Saiyuuki~
source:
One day, Genjou makes up her mind to visit India to get a scripture, which is believed to save the world. She meets Gokuu, Hakkai, Gojou and Gyokuryuu along the way, but it is really hard to take care of them because they have totally different personalities. She somehow continues her trip with them solving various troubles. As they get closer to India, the secret purpose of their trip gradually comes out....

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
一天，玄奘下定决心前往天竺取得据说能够拯救世界的经书。途中，她遇见悟空、八戒、悟净与玉龙。然而几人性格截然不同，照顾起来实在十分辛苦。玄奘一边解决各种麻烦，一边设法与他们继续旅程。随着众人逐渐接近天竺，这场旅行隐藏的真正目的也开始浮出水面…
